platforms.purpose: Retrieve arXiv preprints as platform-native papers: versioned identity, metadata, abstract, and full text.
platforms.select_when: The request names arXiv, supplies an arxiv.org URL or arxiv: ref, or needs arXiv papers rather than general web pages.
examples: find recent arXiv papers on retrieval evaluation
查一下 arXiv 上 q-fin.PM 分类最近的论文

platforms.purpose: Retrieve SSRN working papers as platform-native papers: abstract-ID identity, bibliographic metadata, and the abstract when a route has it.
platforms.select_when: The request names SSRN, supplies an SSRN URL, an ssrn: ref, or a 10.2139/ssrn DOI, or needs SSRN papers (finance, law, economics working papers) rather than general web pages.
examples: find SSRN papers on dual momentum
查一下 SSRN 上关于碳排放监管的论文

platforms.purpose: Find papers across publishers through Google Scholar: cluster identity, byline metadata, citation counts, snippets, links to the versions Google Scholar groups together, and the papers that cite a given paper.
platforms.select_when: The request names Google Scholar, supplies a scholar.google.com cluster URL or scholar: ref, or needs cross-publisher academic discovery, citation counts, or the papers citing a known paper, which arXiv and SSRN do not cover; it needs the user's SerpApi key.
examples: search Google Scholar for time series momentum
how often is "Time series momentum" cited on Google Scholar
which recent papers cite "Time series momentum"
在谷歌学术上查一下行为金融学的综述

platforms.purpose: Search and read Xiaohongshu (小红书, RED) notes in the user's own logged-in Chrome: note identity, title, author, publish time, tags, interaction counts, images, the note text, its comments and replies, and an access URL that opens the note.
platforms.select_when: The request names Xiaohongshu, 小红书 or RED, supplies a xiaohongshu.com note URL, access_url or xiaohongshu: ref, or needs Chinese consumer experience, reviews, and lifestyle posts rather than web pages; it needs the xiaohongshu_browser route enabled by the user.
examples: search Xiaohongshu for coffee grinder reviews
小红书上最近一周关于露营装备的笔记
find the most liked 小红书 notes about Shanghai cafes
看看这篇小红书笔记下面的评论都怎么说

platforms.purpose: Search and read X (formerly Twitter) posts through xAI's x_search tool: post identity, author handle, publication time from the post ID, the post text as the model relayed it, a post's thread, and answers written from X posts alone with cited posts.
platforms.select_when: The request names X or Twitter, supplies an x.com or twitter.com post URL or x: ref, asks what people on X say, or needs posts by given accounts or within given days; it uses the xAI key of main search. General questions keep using forager search.
examples: what are people on X saying about the Rust 2027 edition
list SpaceX's posts about Starship from early October
X 上大家怎么评价这次发布会
看看这条推文下面的讨论

platforms.purpose: Search and read Hacker News (HN) through its public APIs: item identity for stories, comments, polls, and jobs, points and comment counts, a comment's story, whole discussions written to a Markdown file with top-level comments in the rank HN shows, and the current front page and other official lists.
platforms.select_when: The request names Hacker News or HN, supplies a news.ycombinator.com item URL or hn: ref, asks what HN thinks about a topic or what is on the HN front page, or needs the HN discussion of a link; it needs no key. General questions keep using forager search.
examples: what does Hacker News think about the Rust 2027 edition
what is on the HN front page right now
find Show HN posts about self-hosted search from 2025
看看 HN 上大家怎么评价这篇文章

platforms.purpose: Search YouTube videos through the official Data API with the user's own key: video identity, channel, publication time, duration, view, like, and comment counts, whether captions exist, and the publisher's full description and chapters; a video's top-level comments; the videos of a playlist or channel; once the user enables the youtube_web route, also one caption track as a timestamped transcript of what is said. Neither describes what the video shows.
platforms.select_when: The request names YouTube, supplies a youtube.com or youtu.be video URL or a youtube: ref, or needs talks, lectures, tutorials, or interviews on YouTube with filters such as date, length, channel, or captions, what viewers say about a video, the videos of a course, playlist, or channel, or what a video says; search needs a YouTube Data API key and captions need the user-enabled youtube_web route. General questions keep using forager search.
examples: find recent YouTube talks on retrieval augmented generation longer than 20 minutes
what is the description and chapter list of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw
list videos about transformers from the 3Blue1Brown channel that have captions
what do viewers say in the comments of https://youtu.be/jNQXAC9IVRw
list every video in the playlist https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLZHQObOWTQDPD3MizzM2xVFitgF8hE_ab
在 YouTube 上找最近一个月讲 Rust 异步的视频
